preserved_study.policy: Preserve every exact scheduled Standard row and its original outcome. Do not rerun, replace, relabel, or select Standard rows by outcome.

retired_hard_execution.artifact_policy: Pilot artifacts are retained in their original source campaign but are neither imported nor inventoried by the preserved Standard study, avoiding any race with active or terminating processes.

replacement_hard_study.source_identity_policy: Hard-v2 is a separate source study and must never be represented as a continuation of, or relabeling of, the v1 campaign.
replacement_hard_study.design_policy: Retain the originally frozen hard arm, repeat, endpoint, contrast, and multiplicity definitions; execute all 112 rows under the separately frozen hard-v2 recovery campaign.

combined_analysis.row_policy: Combine only independently revalidated canonical row evidence from the two explicitly named source studies.
combined_analysis.source_identity_policy: Retain a source-study identifier and source artifact hashes on every row.
combined_analysis.statistical_policy: Use the already-frozen v1 analyze_results.py implementation and original preregistered contrast families without adaptive additions, deletions, or outcome-conditioned stopping.

disclosure: This is a post-execution recovery amendment. Standard outcomes existed when it was recorded. It changes provenance/execution handling only and does not change Standard assignments, endpoints, contrasts, or denominator. The separate hard-v2 study must be analyzed and disclosed as a recovery study.
